with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='G0483')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with ps as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P' group by 1,2), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), paid as (select ps.payer_class, date_diff('day', ps.first_sub, cur.payment_date) d from ps join cur using(claim_key,payer_key) where cur.paid_amount>0)
select payer_class, count(*) paid_claims, round(median(d),1) median_days, round(quantile_cont(d,0.9),1) p90_days from paid group by 1 order by 1

with cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), denied as (select remit_claim_id from cur where is_denied), codes as (select distinct a.carc_code, a.claim_key, a.payer_key from sem.adjustments a join denied using(remit_claim_id) where a.group_code='CO' and a.is_denial_carc)
select carc_code, count(*) denied_claims from codes group by 1 order by 2 desc, 1 limit 5

with ev as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, count(*) n_events, count(*) filter (where is_current_adjudication and not is_denied and not is_reversal) n_ok from sem.remit_claims group by 1,2),
cls as (select payer_class, count(*) pairs, count(*) filter (where n_events=1 and n_ok=1) fp from ev group by 1)
select payer_class, pairs, fp, round(100.0*fp/pairs,2) rate_pct from cls order by 1

with pr as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, count(distinct check_or_eft_number) traces, bool_or(is_reversal) has_rev, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) has_cur,
  coalesce(sum(paid_amount) filter (where is_current_adjudication),0) cur_paid from sem.remit_claims group by 1,2), multi as (select * from pr where traces>=2)
select payer_class, count(*) pairs, count(*) filter (where has_rev) with_reversal, count(*) filter (where not has_cur) no_current, round(sum(cur_paid),2) current_paid from multi group by 1 order by 1
with cur_lines as (select * from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication), partial as (select * from cur_lines where line_is_denied and not claim_is_denied) select count(*) from partial

with p as (select distinct claim_key, payer_key from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P'), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), prim_cur as (select cur.remit_claim_id from cur join p using(claim_key,payer_key)),
ded as (select a.adjustment_amount from sem.adjustments a join prim_cur using(remit_claim_id) where a.group_code='PR' and a.carc_code='1')
select coalesce(round(sum(adjustment_amount),2),0) deductible from ded

with c as (select date_trunc('month', service_date_from) m, referring_npi npi from sem.claims where is_latest_submission and service_date_from>=date '2026-06-01'),
totals as (select m, count(*) total from c group by 1), ranked as (select m, npi, count(*) n, row_number() over (partition by m order by count(*) desc, npi) rk from c where npi is not null group by 1,2),
top5 as (select m, sum(n) top5 from ranked where rk<=5 group by 1)
select strftime(totals.m,'%Y-%m') as month_, total, top5, round(100.0*top5/total,1) as top5_share_pct from totals join top5 using(m) order by 1

with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='87798')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), billed as (select distinct claim_key, payer_key, procedure_code from sem.claim_lines where is_latest_submission),
x as (select b.procedure_code, cur.is_denied from cur join billed b using(claim_key,payer_key))
select procedure_code, count(*) adjudications, round(avg(is_denied::INT),4) denial_rate from x group by 1 having count(*)>=20 order by 3 desc, 1

with latest as (select claim_key, payer_key, line_count, charge_amount from sem.claims where is_latest_submission and payer_responsibility='P'), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication),
j as (select case when l.line_count>=3 then '3+' else l.line_count::varchar end bucket, l.charge_amount, cur.is_denied from latest l join cur using(claim_key,payer_key))
select bucket, count(*) claims, count(*) filter (where is_denied) denied, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where is_denied)/count(*),2) rate_pct, coalesce(sum(charge_amount) filter (where is_denied),0) denied_charge from j group by 1 order by 1

with fb as (select * from sem.provider_adjustments where plb_reason_code='FB'), cf as (select * from fb where provider_adjustment_amount<0),
off as (select cf.provider_adjustment_id, min(o.payment_date) off_date from cf join fb o on o.payer_key=cf.payer_key and o.reference_id=cf.reference_id and o.provider_adjustment_amount=-cf.provider_adjustment_amount and o.payment_date>cf.payment_date group by 1)
select cf.reference_id, cf.payment_date, round(-cf.provider_adjustment_amount,2) amount, off.off_date, date_diff('day', cf.payment_date, off.off_date) days_between from cf left join off using(provider_adjustment_id) order by 2,1

with cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), m as (select payer_class, sum(paid_amount) filter (where payment_month=date '2026-07-01') jul, sum(paid_amount) filter (where payment_month=date '2026-08-01') aug from cur group by 1),
s as (select payer_class, 100.0*jul/sum(jul) over () js, 100.0*aug/sum(aug) over () a_s from m)
select payer_class, round(js,1) jul_share, round(a_s,1) aug_share, round(a_s-js,1) change_pp from s order by 1

with subs as (select claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) filter (where frequency_code='1') orig, min(submission_date) filter (where frequency_code='7') repl from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P' group by 1,2),
corrected as (select * from subs where repl is not null), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), after as (select c.*, cur.payment_date, cur.paid_amount from corrected c join cur using(claim_key,payer_key) where cur.payment_date>=c.repl)
select (select count(*) from corrected) n, (select round(avg(date_diff('day',orig,repl)),2) from corrected) avg_days_to_repl, count(*) paid_after, round(avg(date_diff('day',orig,payment_date)),2) avg_days_to_pay, coalesce(sum(paid_amount),0) total_paid from after

with v as (select claim_key, min(submission_date) void_date from sem.claims where frequency_code='8' group by 1),
paid_before as (select distinct v.claim_key from v join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key) where r.paid_amount>0 and r.payment_date<v.void_date),
rev as (select distinct v.claim_key from v join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key) where r.is_reversal and r.payment_date>=v.void_date),
cp as (select sum(r.paid_amount) p from v join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key) where r.is_current_adjudication)
select (select count(*) from v), (select count(*) from paid_before), (select count(*) from rev), round(coalesce((select p from cp),0),2)
with cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), z as (select * from cur where paid_amount=0 and not is_denied) select count(*) from z

with corr as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) repl from sem.claims where frequency_code='7' group by 1,2), resp as (select c.payer_class, c.claim_key, c.payer_key, date_diff('day', c.repl, min(r.payment_date)) d from corr c join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key,payer_key) where r.payment_date>=c.repl group by c.payer_class,c.claim_key,c.payer_key,c.repl)
select payer_class, count(*) corrected_claims, round(avg(d),1) avg_days, min(d) min_days, max(d) max_days from resp group by 1 order by 1
with pr as (select claim_key, payer_key, bool_or(is_reversal) rev, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) cur from sem.remit_claims group by 1,2) select count(*) from pr where rev and not cur

with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='80307')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with ps as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P' group by 1,2), cohort as (select * from ps where first_sub between date '2026-07-01' and date '2026-07-31'),
fr as (select claim_key, payer_key, min(payment_date) first_remit from sem.remit_claims group by 1,2),
j as (select c.payer_class, date_diff('day', c.first_sub, fr.first_remit) d from cohort c left join fr using(claim_key,payer_key))
select payer_class, count(*) claims, count(*) filter (where d<=14) within_14, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where d<=14)/count(*),1) pct from j group by 1 order by 1

with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='G0482')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with corr as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) repl from sem.claims where frequency_code='7' group by 1,2), rec_den as (select distinct c.claim_key, c.payer_key, c.repl from corr c join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key,payer_key) where r.claim_status_code='4' and r.payment_date<c.repl),
after as (select distinct d.claim_key, d.payer_key from rec_den d join sem.remit_claims r using(claim_key,payer_key) where r.payment_date>=d.repl), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication),
o as (select d.claim_key, case when a.claim_key is null then 'no remit since correction' when cur.is_denied is false then 'overturned' else 'denied again' end outcome, coalesce(cur.paid_amount,0) paid
 from rec_den d left join after a using(claim_key,payer_key) left join cur using(claim_key,payer_key))
select outcome, count(*) claims, round(sum(paid),2) total_paid from o group by 1 order by 1

with prior_den as (select distinct claim_key, payer_key from sem.remit_claims where not is_current_adjudication and not is_reversal and is_denied), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication),
ov as (select cur.* from cur join prior_den using(claim_key,payer_key) where not cur.is_denied)
select count(*) overturned, coalesce(round(sum(paid_amount),2),0) current_paid from ov

with ps as (select claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P' group by 1,2), latest as (select claim_key, payer_key, frequency_code, charge_amount from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P' and is_latest_submission), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication),
open_ as (select ps.*, l.charge_amount, date_diff('day', ps.first_sub, date '2026-08-14') age from ps join latest l using(claim_key,payer_key) left join cur using(claim_key,payer_key) where l.frequency_code<>'8' and cur.remit_claim_id is null)
select case when age<=14 then '0-14' when age<=29 then '15-29' else '30+' end bucket, count(*) claims, sum(charge_amount) billed from open_ group by 1 order by 1

with fs as (select claim_key, min(submission_date) first_submission from sem.claims group by 1), jul as (select * from fs where date_trunc('month', first_submission)=date '2026-07-01'),
remitted as (select distinct claim_key from sem.remit_claims) select count(*) from jul where claim_key not in (select claim_key from remitted)

with l as (select payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount a from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication and not line_is_denied and units_paid=1 and line_allowed_amount>0),
freq as (select payer_name, procedure_code, a, count(*) cnt from l group by 1,2,3), typ as (select payer_name, procedure_code, a typical from (select *, row_number() over (partition by payer_name, procedure_code order by cnt desc, a desc) rn from freq) where rn=1),
j as (select l.payer_name, l.a, t.typical from l join typ t using(payer_name, procedure_code))
select payer_name, count(*) filter (where a<typical) underpaid_lines, round(coalesce(sum(typical-a) filter (where a<typical),0),2) shortfall from j group by 1 order by 3 desc, 1

with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='G0480')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication), m as (select payer_class, strftime(payment_month,'%Y-%m') month_, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where is_denied) denied, 100.0*count(*) filter (where is_denied)/count(*) rate from cur group by 1,2)
select payer_class, month_, n, denied, round(rate,2) rate_pct, round(rate - lag(rate) over (partition by payer_class order by month_),2) change_pp from m order by 1,2

with lines as (select procedure_code, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication),
tot as (select sum(line_paid_amount) total_paid from lines), cpt as (select sum(line_paid_amount) cpt_paid from lines where procedure_code='81479')
select round(cpt_paid/total_paid,4) share from cpt, tot

with c as (select distinct claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi from sem.claims where payer_responsibility='P'), cur as (select * from sem.remit_claims where is_current_adjudication),
j as (select c.referring_npi, cur.is_denied from c join cur using(claim_key,payer_key))
select referring_npi, round(avg(is_denied::INT),4) denial_rate, count(*) claims from j group by 1 having count(*)>=15 order by 2 desc, 1 limit 5
